---
repo-actions: false
image: "assets/media/social-card.png"
date-format: iso
include-after-body:
  - file: assets/scripts/quarto-extensions-listing.html
grid:
  sidebar-width: 100px
  body-width: 1200px
  margin-width: 100px
---

```{=html}
<div id="extensions-listing" data-index="extensions-index.json" data-page-size="24">

  <form id="listing-controls" class="mb-4" role="search" onsubmit="return false;">
    <div class="grid align-items-center mb-3">
      <div class="g-col-12 g-col-md-8">
        <div class="input-group">
          <span class="input-group-text"><i class="bi bi-search" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>
          <input type="search" id="extension-search" class="form-control"
            placeholder="Search extensions, authors, categories…" aria-label="Search extensions">
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="g-col-12 g-col-md-4 text-md-end">
        <div class="btn-group" role="group" aria-label="View toggle">
          <input type="radio" class="btn-check" name="view-toggle" id="grid-view" checked>
          <label class="btn btn-outline-body" for="grid-view">
            <i class="bi bi-grid-3x3-gap" aria-hidden="true"></i> Grid
          </label>
          <input type="radio" class="btn-check" name="view-toggle" id="list-view">
          <label class="btn btn-outline-body" for="list-view">
            <i class="bi bi-list-ul" aria-hidden="true"></i> List
          </label>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="quick-filters mb-3">
      <div class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-2 justify-content-center align-items-center">
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-success filter-chip" data-filter="test-pass"
          aria-pressed="false">
          <i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i> Passing
        </button>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger filter-chip" data-filter="test-fail"
          aria-pressed="false">
          <i class="bi bi-x-circle-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i> Failing
        </button>
        <div class="btn-group flex-wrap" role="group" aria-label="Contribution filters">
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary filter-chip" data-filter="shortcode"
            aria-label="Shortcodes" aria-pressed="false">
            <i class="bi bi-code-square" aria-hidden="true"></i>
            <span class="d-none d-sm-inline">Shortcodes</span>
          </button>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary filter-chip" data-filter="filter"
            aria-label="Filters" aria-pressed="false">
            <i class="bi bi-funnel" aria-hidden="true"></i>
            <span class="d-none d-sm-inline">Filters</span>
          </button>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary filter-chip" data-filter="format"
            aria-label="Formats" aria-pressed="false">
            <i class="bi bi-file-earmark-code" aria-hidden="true"></i>
            <span class="d-none d-sm-inline">Formats</span>
          </button>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary filter-chip" data-filter="project"
            aria-label="Projects" aria-pressed="false">
            <i class="bi bi-folder" aria-hidden="true"></i>
            <span class="d-none d-sm-inline">Projects</span>
          </button>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary filter-chip" data-filter="revealjs-plugin"
            aria-label="Reveal.js Plugins" aria-pressed="false">
            <i class="bi bi-sliders" aria-hidden="true"></i>
            <span class="d-none d-sm-inline">Reveal.js Plugins</span>
          </button>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary filter-chip" data-filter="metadata"
            aria-label="Metadata" aria-pressed="false">
            <i class="bi bi-info-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i>
            <span class="d-none d-sm-inline">Metadata</span>
          </button>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-body" id="clear-filters">
          <i class="bi bi-x-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i> Clear
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="grid align-items-center">
      <div class="g-col-12 g-col-sm-6">
        <label class="visually-hidden" for="category-filter">Filter by category</label>
        <select class="form-select form-select-sm" id="category-filter">
          <option value="">All categories</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <div class="g-col-12 g-col-sm-6">
        <div class="input-group input-group-sm">
          <label class="input-group-text" for="sort-field">Sort</label>
          <select class="form-select" id="sort-field">
            <option value="modified">Recently updated</option>
            <option value="stars">Stars</option>
            <option value="title">Name</option>
          </select>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-body" id="sort-direction" data-direction="desc"
            aria-label="Sort descending">
            <i class="bi bi-sort-down" aria-hidden="true"></i>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </form>

  <p id="extensions-counter" class="mb-3 text-muted text-center" aria-live="polite">
    <em>Loading extensions…</em>
  </p>

  <noscript>
    <div class="alert alert-warning" role="alert">
      This catalogue is rendered in the browser. Enable JavaScript, or browse the source list on
      <a href="https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-extensions/blob/main/extensions/quarto-extensions.csv">GitHub</a>.
    </div>
  </noscript>

  <div id="extensions-results" class="grid" role="list"></div>

  <div id="extensions-empty" class="d-none">
    <i class="bi bi-search" aria-hidden="true"></i>
    <p class="mt-3 mb-1"><strong>No extensions match the current filters.</strong></p>
    <p class="text-muted">Try a different search term, or clear the filters to start again.</p>
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-body btn-sm" id="empty-clear-filters">
      <i class="bi bi-x-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i> Clear filters
    </button>
  </div>

  <div class="text-center my-4">
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-body d-none" id="load-more">Load more</button>
  </div>

  <div class="modal fade" id="extension-modal" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="extension-modal-label" aria-hidden="true">
    <div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered modal-lg">
      <div class="modal-content">
        <div class="modal-header">
          <h2 class="modal-title h5 no-anchor" id="extension-modal-label"></h2>
          <button type="button" class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal" aria-label="Close"></button>
        </div>
        <div class="modal-body" id="extension-modal-body"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>
```
